title: Fix Single-Line Field Overflow Sizing and Truncation
description: Fix Single-Line Field Overflow Sizing and Truncation
summary: Fixed single-line field overflow in the sketchpad Details panel. Increased chevron indicator icons from 8px to 10px with heavier stroke weight (2.5). Expanded the overflow second-row container from 10px to 14px height and the grid template accordingly. Raised the stacked layout min-height from 32px to 46px so the 2-row expansion properly pushes adjacent rows down with no overlap. Changed the first-row text leading from a tight 12px to leading-normal for cleaner truncation rendering. All 30 existing tests pass.
